meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会排查 Azure Event Hubs / Service Bus 的 SDK 问题:查资源健康、比对报错、搜 Microsoft Learn 文档、核对配置,再给出修复建议。覆盖连接、认证、消息锁等故障。
howto.when: 当你提到 Event Hub、Service Bus 的 SDK 报错或 AMQP 错误,或遇到连接失败、消息锁丢失、检查点重置等故障时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude diagnoses Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK issues: checks resource health, matches the error, searches Microsoft Learn docs, verifies config, then suggests a fix. Covers connection, auth, and message lock errors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Event Hub or Service Bus SDK errors, AMQP errors, or hit issues like connection failures, message lock lost, or checkpoint resets.

say_en.text: My Event Hub consumer isn't receiving messages, help me check
say_en.note: Checks resource health, then matches the error

say_en.text: Service Bus reports message lock lost, how do I fix it?
Check my Event Hub connection string and consumer group config
